text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're going to coordinate an outfit 
for me...! Are you serious?! City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Since it's your birthday celebration and 
all. So, what kind of thing do you want?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What style...? Um...! Wah, I don't 
really know anything about brands...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to overthink it. Just going 
by the vibe is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah— then, out of all the outfits you've 
worn so far, which one's your absolute 
favorite?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, here's my Sansa Odori 
outfit!! My mom stayed up all night sewing 
it for me~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait! That's not what you meant, right? 
Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Traditional performing arts, huh...? 
Traditional Japanese patterns... no, maybe 
incorporate dyed fabric...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So hard...! But I'll definitely nail 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san...! That's amazin', yer a real 
pro, aren'tcha~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pro... Well, more like, I did it for you, 
y'know...?
